Privacy

Tab cloaking — open this desktop in a disguised window so the address bar shows a blank or blob URL.

about:blank cloak

Opens a new window at about:blank and embeds this page inside it. The tab URL reads about:blank.

Blob cloak

Opens a new window with a blob: URL that embeds this page. The tab shows a blob address instead of the real site.

Allow pop-ups for this site if the window is blocked. Cloaking only affects the new window’s URL bar.
